attempted_claim: Let F be the family of graphs on 32 vertices containing the 31-vertex orthogonal polarity graph ER_5 as an induced subgraph. Every C4-free graph G on 32 vertices satisfies e(G)<=92, and if e(G)>=86 then G is at edit distance at most 6 from some member of F.
claim_type: extremal-density upper bound with stability-fragment and sporadic extremal witness test
decisive_failure: No general proof of the <=92 cap (KST stalls at 97); stability clause unprobed; heuristic campaigns (plateau 92 for C4-free, 85 for girth>=5) are evidence, not proof; ER_5 extension-ceiling lemma covers only ER_5-induced hosts.
